description_en: Performs a paged query for currently published chunks in a knowledge base. Results can be filtered by asset, keyword, and enabled status. If an assetId is specified, results are sorted by chunkSeq, and the nextToken is attached to the current publish result of the asset. A VersionConflict (409) error is returned if the publish result changes. If no assetId is specified, results are sorted by assetId and chunkSeq, and a full-base snapshot is not guaranteed. The token is always attached to the tenant, workspace, knowledge base, filter conditions, and sorting
description_zh: 分页查询知识库中当前已发布的 Chunk，可按资产、关键词和启用状态过滤。指定 assetId 时按 chunkSeq 排序，nextToken 绑定该资产的当前发布结果，发布结果变化返回 VersionConflict（409）。未指定 assetId 时按 assetId、chunkSeq 排序，不承诺全库快照。令牌始终绑定租户、工作空间、知识库、过滤条件和排序
name: ListChunks

parameters.help_en: The workspace ID. Magic resolves the tenant ID from the trusted gateway call identity to verify workspace ownership. Knowledge bases are created or accessed within this tenant and workspace. Cross-tenant queries are not supported by using only the knowledgeBaseId
parameters.help_zh: 由 Magic 从可信网关调用身份解析 tenantId 并校验工作空间归属；知识库在该租户及工作空间内创建或访问，不能仅凭 knowledgeBaseId 跨租户查询
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the knowledge base
parameters.name: knowledge_base_id

parameters.help_en: The asset ID. This parameter is optional. If specified, only chunks in the current published generation of the asset are queried. If omitted, the entire knowledge base is queried
parameters.help_zh: 可选。指定时仅查询该资产当前已发布代次的 Chunk；省略时查询整个知识库
parameters.name: asset_id

parameters.help_en: The keyword used to filter chunk content. The maximum length is 1,024 characters. This parameter is allowed only when assetId is specified. Otherwise, an InvalidParameter error is returned
parameters.help_zh: 按切片正文关键词过滤，最长 1024 个字符；仅指定 assetId 时允许使用，否则返回 InvalidParameter
parameters.name: keyword

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to filter by enabled status. Valid values:
true: Queries only enabled chunks.
false: Queries only disabled chunks.
If this parameter is omitted, chunks are not filtered by enabled status
parameters.help_zh: true 仅查询启用的切片，false 仅查询禁用的切片；省略时不按启用状态过滤
parameters.name: enabled

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of results to return per page. Valid values: 0 to 100. If this parameter is omitted or set to 0, the default value 20 is used
parameters.help_zh: 取值范围为 0～100；省略或传入 0 时按 20 返回
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The token returned in the previous response for pagination. The token is bound to the tenant, workspace, knowledge base, filter conditions, and sorting, and cannot be reused across different scopes. If assetId is specified, the token is also bound to the current publish result. A VersionConflict (409) error is returned if the publish result changes. Cross-asset pagination is sorted by assetId and chunkSeq, and a full-base snapshot is not guaranteed
parameters.help_zh: 上一次响应返回的 nextToken，绑定租户、工作空间、知识库、过滤条件和排序，不可跨范围复用。指定 assetId 时还绑定当前发布结果，发布结果变化返回 VersionConflict（409）。跨资产分页按 assetId、chunkSeq 排序，不承诺全库快照
parameters.name: next_token

items.description_en: The currently published chunks. Chunks within a single asset are sorted by chunkSeq. Chunks across assets are sorted by assetId and chunkSeq
items.description_zh: 当前已发布的 Chunk。单资产内按 chunkSeq 排序，跨资产按 assetId、chunkSeq 排序

assetId.description_en: The asset to which the chunk belongs

chunkSeq.description_en: The logical sequence number that starts from 1 within the published asset. Resplitting may change the sequence number. You must pass back the chunkToken of this chunk when you edit it
chunkSeq.description_zh: 已发布资产内从 1 开始的逻辑序号；重切分可能改变序号，编辑时须同时回传该项 chunkToken

chunkSize.description_en: The number of UTF-16 code units in the chunk content. This metric follows the EB ChunkSize calculation standard
chunkSize.description_zh: Chunk 正文的 UTF-16 码元数量，沿用 EB 的 ChunkSize 口径

chunkToken.description_en: The opaque token that must be passed back as is during updates. The token is validated against the current publish result at the beginning of the request. An error is returned if the token has expired. After a pure enable or disable operation starts, the token does not follow new concurrent publish results. Do not parse or generate this token
chunkToken.description_zh: 更新时原样回传的不透明令牌；请求开始时按当前发布结果校验，已过期则报错。纯启停开始后不追随并发发布的新结果，不解析或自行生成

content.description_en: The content of the currently published chunk
content.description_zh: 当前已发布 Chunk 正文

createdAt.description_en: The creation time in ISO 8601 format in UTC

enabled.description_en: Indicates whether the chunk is enabled. Disabled chunks are not included in searches. Administrative permissions are still required for chunk O&M queries
enabled.description_zh: 禁用的 Chunk 不参与检索；Chunk 运维查询仍须管理权限

fileName.description_en: The name of the source file that corresponds to the published chunk
fileName.description_zh: 该已发布 Chunk 对应的原件文件名

sourceLocation.description_en: The location in the source file. The format follows the EB positioning convention, such as p.3 for PDF files, s.2 for PPT files, or the worksheet name for spreadsheets. The previous location is not returned if manual editing invalidates the mapping
sourceLocation.description_zh: 沿用 EB 定位形式，如 PDF 的 p.3、PPT 的 s.2 或表格工作表名。人工编辑使映射失效时不返回旧位置

titlePath.description_en: The hierarchical heading path where the chunk is located. This parameter is not returned if the location cannot be determined
titlePath.description_zh: Chunk 所在的标题层级路径；不可定位时不返回

updatedAt.description_en: The update time in ISO 8601 format in UTC

maxResults.description_en: The page size used for the current request
maxResults.description_zh: 本次请求采用的分页大小

message.description_en: The description of the data masking result

nextToken.description_en: The token for the next page. Pass this value as is in the nextToken parameter of the subsequent request to continue pagination. If this value is empty, all results have been returned
nextToken.description_zh: 继续分页时原样传入上一次响应中的 nextToken；为空时结束

success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful

totalCount.description_en: The total number of chunks that match the filter conditions in the current published generation of the asset. This parameter is returned only when assetId is specified. It is not returned for cross-asset queries
totalCount.description_zh: 仅指定 assetId 时返回，为该资产当前已发布代次中符合过滤条件的总数；跨资产查询不返回
